title: Composed supervisory control: Fill-mix-drain sequence -> State sequence with per-stage timeout

inputs.name: B_Stop
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Stop and reset-to-idle command

outputs.name: A_State
outputs.description: Subsystem A: 0 idle, 1 fill, 2 mix, 3 drain

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan A_Start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem B: Sensor completion is expected within 500 ms of entering each stage.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Start in idle shall enter fill and open only A_FillValve.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_HighLevel shall transition fill to mix; A_MixDone transitions mix to drain.
requirements.property: G((A_State=1 AND A_HighLevel)->X(A_State=2)) AND G((A_State=2 AND A_MixDone)->X(A_State=3))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_LowLevel in drain shall return to idle and pulse A_Complete for one scan.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_FillValve, A_Mixer, and A_DrainValve shall be mutually exclusive and correspond to A_State.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Abort shall immediately return to idle, close all actuators, and suppress A_Complete.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Start in idle shall enter stage 1 and energize only B_Actuator1.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=0 AND B_Start AND !B_Fault AND !B_Stop)->X(B_State=1)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Sensor1 shall transition stage 1 to stage 2; B_Sensor2 shall B_Complete stage 2 and return idle.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=1 AND B_Sensor1)->X(B_State=2))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=2 AND B_Sensor2)->X(B_State=0)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Either stage remaining incomplete for 500 ms shall latch B_Fault and return idle with both actuators off.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (stage_timeout -> (B_Fault AND B_State=0 AND !B_Actuator1 AND !B_Actuator2)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop shall return idle and turn both actuators off without clearing B_Fault.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_ResetFault clears B_Fault only while B_Stop is TRUE and B_Start is FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_ResetFault AND B_Stop AND !B_Start)->!B_Fault))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Complete shall pulse only on the stage-2-to-idle completion transition.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Complete = (prev(B_State)=2 AND B_Sensor2 AND !B_Stop AND !B_Fault)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_FillValve shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Actuator1 AND NOT B_Actuator2 AND NOT B_Complete AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Actuator1 AND NOT B_Actuator2 AND NOT B_Complete AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
